source_text: Filii Ioseph: Una sors non sufficit. Iesus: Ascende in silvam et succide. Labor adiciendus gratiae. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Sons of-Joseph: One lot not suffices. Jesus: Go-up into forest and cut. Labor to-be-added to-grace. Amen.
pass_b_english: Joseph’s sons: [[One lot is not enough >> Bible:Joshua 17:14]]. Jesus: [[Go up to the forest and clear it >> Bible:Joshua 17:15]]. Labor must be added to grace. Amen.
